summary: Added src/slug.js (slugify: lowercases only ASCII A-Z, collapses non-[a-z0-9] runs to one '-', trims edge hyphens) and test/slug.test.js covering A1/A2 including non-ASCII (café, İ) and empty-result boundaries. Slug lane passes; full node --test passes (4 tests).
notes: String.prototype.toLowerCase would turn 'İ' into 'i'+combining dot, leaking an ASCII letter; lowercasing is restricted to A-Z to honor rule 1/2.
slugify('!!!') returns '' per D1; pageId is not part of this unit.
Changes are uncommitted in the worktree.
